responsibility: Provides RTL induction-variable analysis and simple loop-exit iteration-count reasoning used by several loop optimizers. It caches and exposes rtx_iv descriptions for register uses and defs within the current loop, walks use-def chains to identify basic and derived induction variables, computes expressions for loop exit counts and assumptions, and builds the reusable niter_desc/simple-loop description selected from suitable exits. Passes such as unrolling, doloop optimization, and branch prediction consume this file’s IV and trip-count services rather than reanalyzing loops themselves.
